answer_1.quote: Automatic question generation (AQG) based on a passage and a target answer has attracted much attention in recent years.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our model with three standard evaluation metrics: BLEU (BLEU-4), METEOR and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to measure the quality of questions generated by our approach. Specifically, similar to the metrics used in , we consider two criterion in human evaluation: (1) Naturalness, which indicates the grammaticality and fluency of the generated questions; and (2) Answerability, which measures the correctness of the question, i.e., whether it can achieve the answer.
answer_4.guideline: Three professional English speakers rate the generated questions on a 1 to 5 scale for Naturalness and Answerability.
